Pada 6 Mei 1976, semasa Perang Ikan Kod (Cod Wars), HMS Mermaid berhadapan dengan kapal Pengawal Pantai Iceland, Baldur, dalam satu insiden. Sebuah papan gambar sezaman merakamkan insiden ini dengan kapsyen 'ICGV Baldur's can opening technique as attempted on H.M.S. Mermaid on 6th May 76'.
Item 1: 'bertembung' can imply a collision; 'berhadapan dengan … dalam satu insiden' is neutral, matching the English 'encounter'.

On 4 February 2009 KD Hang Tuah sailed from Lumut for Op FAJAR 03/2008, the TLDM operation to escort Malaysian merchant ships safely through the Gulf of Aden, where ships were being seized by pirates. On 13 February 2009, in waters off Salalah, Oman, she took over the task from KD Sri Indera Sakti. During the deployment she called at Salalah and at Aden, where her commanding officer called on the Governor of Aden. She returned to Lumut on 14 May 2009, 100 days after sailing.

She took over the task from KD Sri Indera Sakti and returned to Lumut on 14 May 2009, 100 days after sailing.

Kapal ini kembali ke Lumut pada 14 Mei 2009, 100 hari selepas belayar.
